text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufufu~n♪ What should I do for the upcoming fan meeting~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Since it's "giving back love"... A live show is fine and all, but Karen feels like it needs a bit more punch—
(Chime~♪)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, LANE... It's from Mom and the family! ...Fufufu, the usual stuff, huh?

text_block_list.name: Karen's Family
text_block_list.text: Welcome home, Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah! What an amazing banner this time too♡ Thank you so much for welcoming me back, everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Karen's Mother
text_block_list.text: Sorry about this, dear. Even though you're so busy... It's just that our "Karen deficiency" got the better of us...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: It's totally okay! Karen wanted to catch her breath for a bit too, and—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: More than anything, I really wanted to see everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Karen's Family
text_block_list.text: Hawawa, adorable Curren Chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Eh, Karen knows this! This cake is from that super famous pâtisserie in Hokkaido, right?

text_block_list.name: Karen's Father
text_block_list.text: Haha. For my cute daughter, Papa would fly all the way to Hong Kong to buy treats.

text_block_list.name: Karen's Mother
text_block_list.text: Here you go, Curren Chan. Freshly made carrot juice! It's super fresh~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Papa, Mama! ...Are the flowers on the table coordinated to match Karen's image, too?

text_block_list.name: Karen's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Yep, it's my handmade concept bouquet! The Karen merch shrine on the second floor has evolved too♪

text_block_list.name: Karen's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: I've been collecting tons of Karen-oneechan photo cards too! I even got the rare ones!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Wah, really? Show them to Karen later, okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Karen's Mother
text_block_list.text: —My, is it already this late? Time just flies when Curren Chan is around.

text_block_list.name: Karen's Father
text_block_list.text: You're right... Whew, this is no good. I'm already feeling lonely having to say goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Jeez, everyone! Karen is still right here, so don't get all gloomy!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's it! At times like this... we need *that*♪
(Plink, plonk~♪ Plink, plonk~♪)

text_block_list.name: Karen's Mother
text_block_list.text: ! This is the song her big brother used to play all the time...

text_block_list.name: Karen's Father
text_block_list.text: I see, Karen learned piano from him... Fufu. Whenever there was a party, it always meant this song.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Feelings carry through sound."
"When you're happy, joyful notes ring out."
"Music is a letter that can never tell a lie"—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Pop quiz! What kind of feelings is Karen having right now~?

text_block_list.name: Karen's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Me, me! You're feeling super duper happy!

text_block_list.name: Karen's Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that must be the right answer! Because Mama feels like singing along now! La-la-la~♪

text_block_list.name: Karen's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: Hm-hm-hm~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: (Music is a letter, huh—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that sounds great! It's decided♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for today, everyone! Thanks to you, Karen got a huge help!

text_block_list.name: Karen's Father
text_block_list.text: That's our line. ...Still, we're glad to hear that.

text_block_list.name: Karen's Mother
text_block_list.text: You're so clever, so there probably isn't much we can do to help you, but...

text_block_list.name: Karen's Older Sister
text_block_list.text: The one thing we're truly confident in is our love for you, Karen! So whenever you want to be pampered, come home anytime!

text_block_list.name: Karen's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text: Next time you come home, I'll play the piano for you, Karen-oneechan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Everyone... Yeah, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I love you all so much!
One day. Curren Chan was playing the piano in an empty classroom. ...Taken aback by the unexpected sight, words slipped out of my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, are you curious?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Too bad... It's still a secret for now♪ —Keep your heart fluttering while you wait for the answer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you! It's all thanks to my teacher's lessons♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes! To Karen, he's the most wonderful, amazing teacher in the whole wide world...♪
